pages.title: Moving Day

pages.title: Moving Day
pages.text: Move an eligible pet while preserving its data; leads and upgrade bases support the next safe relocation.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Sneak-use the native catcher on a permitted animal. Basic handles passive mobs; advanced may handle hostile mobs within server restrictions. Preserve native ownership and entity data.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Mob Catcher sneak-captures eligible passive mobs into real slots and releases them; advanced may support hostile mobs. Boss restrictions and ownership remain native.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Adapter extends eligible Mob leashing and transfers your led mobs to a wall knot; use ordinary animals safely, not as a boss-rule bypass tutorial.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Jade providers show supported taming/food/boss information from owning data; a hint does not mean every mob is tameable or accepts arbitrary food.
